How we work

Every project follows the same clear path, so you always know what comes next.

  1. Home visit and measuringWe visit your home, measure every window and listen to how you live.
  2. Design and fabricsFabric samples, styles and mood boards for your approval.
  3. SelectionFabrics, linings, rods and trims, with a clear price.
  4. Tailoring and installationOur workshop sews your order and our team installs it on site.

About the store

Istanbul Perde is a leading luxury destination for premium curtains and blinds in Duhok, Iraq. With over 25 years of experience, we offer an extensive selection of high-quality fabrics, textures, and colors to suit a wide range of interior styles. We are committed to exceptional craftsmanship, meticulous attention to detail, and outstanding service at every stage—from precise measurements to professional installation—ensuring the highest standards of quality and elegance in every project.
